queries.proxyHosts: select id, domain_names, forward_scheme, forward_host, forward_port, access_list_id, certificate_id, ssl_forced, caching_enabled, block_exploits, length(advanced_config) as advanced_length, allow_websocket_upgrade, http2_support, enabled, locations, hsts_enabled, hsts_subdomains, trust_forwarded_proto from proxy_host where is_deleted = 0 order by id limit 501
queries.redirectHosts: select id, domain_names, forward_domain_name, forward_scheme, forward_http_code, preserve_path, certificate_id, ssl_forced, block_exploits, length(advanced_config) as advanced_length, http2_support, enabled, hsts_enabled, hsts_subdomains from redirection_host where is_deleted = 0 order by id limit 501
queries.accessLists: select id, name, satisfy_any, pass_auth from access_list where is_deleted = 0 order by id limit 501
queries.accessClients: select id, access_list_id, address, directive from access_list_client order by id limit 501
queries.authCounts: select access_list_id, count(*) as count from access_list_auth group by access_list_id order by access_list_id limit 501
queries.certificates: select id, provider, nice_name, domain_names from certificate where is_deleted = 0 order by id limit 501
queries.deadHosts: select id, domain_names from dead_host where is_deleted = 0 order by id limit 501
queries.streams: select id, incoming_port from stream where is_deleted = 0 order by id limit 501
